_comment: The Assumptions Bank's closed vocabulary (docs/assumptions-bank.md §4.2): each kind and the units a row of that kind may be written in. Read by scripts/assumption_lint.py and held equal to quiz/src/lib/assumptionBank.ts by assumptionBank.test.ts. A `fact` row has no unit and its value is the document's words.
_bases: What kind of figure a row is, in the optional Basis column (docs/tool-template-v2.md §4): a regulator's cap or minimum, a figure it selected or set as a target, a benchmark, or one observed in experience. Held equal to BASES in quiz/src/lib/assumptionBank.ts.
